ImageDescription.value:
The belfry of the Gothic Protestant Church on the Avas Hill, Miskolc, Hungary. The belfry is the new symbol of the city, however, the old symbol (the TV tower) is more widely known.
The bells play a melody in every 15 minutes, a variation of the Westminster Chimes. It is a well-known tune in the city.
